description: This file defines a singleton service class 'PurchasesService' that manages fetching purchase data from an API endpoint '/purchases'. It provides a method 'list' for retrieving paginated purchase histories, leveraging an external API client and data models.

classes.name: PurchasesService
classes.description: A singleton class providing interface to fetch purchase history data, wrapping '/purchases' API endpoint, with methods to list purchases with pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of Purchase objects from the API, defaulting to page 1 and page size 20.
